name: union_null_composite_arm_stays_fallback
description: FALLBACK-BOUNDARY GUARD (family: union_null_composite_arm). A JSON null against a NON-NULLABLE union with a null-SURVIVING arm: string | list<int>. BAML has no null fast path here (try_cast_union's optional exit does not apply), so coerce_union runs the null through every arm — and the LIST arm SURVIVES it: coerce_array's non-array branch wraps the null as one implied element (SingleToArray), the element fails as ArrayItemParseError, and the arm still succeeds as []. A CLASS arm may likewise survive (single-field implied-key / all-defaultable default-fill). A MAP arm does NOT — see list_union_map_arm_rejects_null_stays_fallback, which pins that live. Native does not reproduce the surviving arm, so it DECLINES; the claimed 'got null' error is kept only for a union with no surviving arm AND no default_value (all non-composite leaves). This locks that boundary: native must keep falling back while BAML claims. want live-captured from BAML v0.223 final parse.
